investigate.quote: shall review critical safety incident reports submitted by frontier developers

pass_on.quote: may transmit reports of critical safety incidents and reports from covered employees made pursuant to Chapter 5.1 (commencing with Section 1107)
pass_on.doubt: Receiver is OES or the Attorney General; recipients are Legislature, Governor, federal government, state agencies.

tell_public_aggregate.quote: the Office of Emergency Services shall produce a report with anonymized and aggregated information about critical safety incidents that have been reviewed
tell_public_aggregate.doubt: Aggregate report goes to the Legislature (Section 9795) and the Governor; text says produce and transmit, not publish; coded as aggregate publication.

sender_failure.quote: fails to report an incident as required by Section 22757.13, or fails to comply with its own frontier AI framework shall be subject to a civil penalty

signals.note: Penalty applies by its words to a large frontier developer only; the sender here is a frontier developer (15 days to report, 22757.13(c)(1)). Annual report to Legislature/Governor read as aggregate duty, not as receiver accounting for handling (receiver_failure none; doubtful).

sender_failure.quote: fails to report an incident as required by Section 22757.13, or fails to comply with its own frontier AI framework shall be subject to a civil penalty

signals.note: Text addresses only the developer's duty to disclose within 24 hours to an authority; names no handling duty of the authority. Penalty reaches large frontier developers only. Searched: authority, law enforcement agency, public safety agency, and verbs of codes 1-6.

pass_on.quote: may transmit reports of critical safety incidents and reports from covered employees made pursuant to Chapter 5.1 (commencing with Section 1107)
pass_on.doubt: Covers 'reports of critical safety incidents' generally; not limited to public reports.

tell_public_aggregate.quote: the Office of Emergency Services shall produce a report with anonymized and aggregated information about critical safety incidents that have been reviewed
tell_public_aggregate.doubt: Aggregate report goes to the Legislature (Section 9795) and the Governor; text says produce and transmit, not publish; coded as aggregate publication. Covers public reports only to the extent OES chose to review them.

tell_public_aggregate.doubt: Aggregate report goes to the Legislature (Section 9795) and the Governor; text says produce and transmit, not publish; coded as aggregate publication.

signals.note: Labor Code 1107.1(a) only bars the developer from preventing or retaliating against disclosure; AG duties are in 22757.13(e) and 22757.14(d). 22757.14(d)(1) speaks of reports 'reviewed by the Attorney General' but requires no review (investigate none). Federal authority named as alternative receiver is not coded. Reports exempt from CPRA (22757.13(f)): tell_public none.

acknowledge.quote: including a monthly update to the person who made the disclosure regarding the status of the large frontier developer’s investigation of the disclosure
acknowledge.doubt: Reply to sender is a monthly status update, not a receipt confirmation.

investigate.quote: including a monthly update to the person who made the disclosure regarding the status of the large frontier developer’s investigation of the disclosure and the actions taken by the large frontier developer in response to the disclosure
investigate.doubt: Investigation is presupposed by the update duty, not commanded in terms.

receiver_failure.quote: The court is authorized to award reasonable attorney’s fees to a plaintiff who brings a successful action for a violation of this section.

signals.note: pass_on none: quarterly sharing with officers and directors (1107.1(e)(2)(A)) stays inside the developer, not a public body. receiver_failure named is doubtful: 1107.1(f)-(h) remedies attach to a violation of the section, which includes (e).
